title: The Arts as an Integral Part of Our People and a Strategic National Resource
what_it_is: The Arts as an Integral Part of Our People and a Strategic National Resource

sections.label: Performing arts groups and audiences
sections.summary: Local performing arts groups rose from 2,689 in 2013 to 3,162 in 2016, while tickets sold fell from 2.06 million in 2012 to 1.81 million in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The number of our local performing arts groups is increasing each year, from 2,689 in 2013 to 3,162 in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: However, the audience who are willing to buy tickets to watch a show have been dwindling for the past five years as tickets sold in 2016 was 1.81 million, compared to 2.06 million in 2012.

sections.label: Our SG Arts Plan support
sections.summary: NAC announced the five-year Our SG Arts Plan, which includes increasing support for freelance arts professionals and setting up a Resource Centre for them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: NAC has recently announced the five-year "Our SG Arts Plan", in which many practical suggestions were raised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One of them is to increase the support for freelance arts professionals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This year, NAC set up a Resource Centre for the freelance arts professionals, providing services, such as legal support, financial planning and contract samples.

sections.label: Culture Pass and civic education
sections.summary: The passage proposes a Culture Pass app with perks or subsidies, and making arts performances part of civic education for Primary 3 or Primary 4 students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: First, we can introduce a Culture Pass app, similar to the ActiveSG app.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The Government can support by giving perks or subsidies, to students especially, so as to encourage Singaporeans to use the subsidies to get tickets to art performances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Second, make attending arts performances as part of civic education for Primary 3 or Primary 4 students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Every primary student should have at least one chance to watch a concert, dance or theatre performance.

sections.label: 2017 Population Survey on the Arts
sections.summary: The 2017 Population Survey on the Arts indicated attendance is on an upward trend, with 54% of Singaporeans attending arts events.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The 2017 Population Survey on the Arts indicated that attendance is on an upward trend, with 54% of Singaporeans attending arts events.

sections.label: Singapore Cultural Statistics attendance
sections.summary: According to the Singapore Cultural Statistics, there were 1.8 million ticketed attendances in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: According to the Singapore Cultural Statistics, there were 1.8 million ticketed attendances in 2016.

sections.label: Cultural Medallion awards
sections.summary: Since 1979, 125 people have been awarded the Cultural Medallion, Singapore's highest artistic accolade.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Singapore has been privileged to have outstanding artists, able to capture and transmit the essence of what it means to be Singaporean through their work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: This is why since 1979, 125 have been awarded with the Cultural Medallion, which is Singapore’s highest artistic accolade.

sections.label: Our SG Arts Plan launch
sections.summary: NAC launched Our SG Arts Plan in October 2018 to chart strategies and policies over the next five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: NAC launched Our SG Arts Plan in October 2018 to build on these existing efforts and chart strategies and policies over the next five years.

sections.label: Arts engagement for youths
sections.summary: MCCY and NAC work with MOE and ECDA on schemes and courses for youths to engage more with the arts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: MCCY and NAC work closely with partners like MOE and the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) for our youths to engage more with the arts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: These include the Artist-in-School Scheme, Arts Education Programme, museum-based and performing arts-based learning experiences, the School of the Arts (SOTA) as well as undergraduate and postgraduate courses in the arts and culture.

sections.label: Traditional arts capabilities and research
sections.summary: NAC will build capabilities and enhance research on traditional arts under Our SG Arts Plan, with the revamped Stamford Arts Centre housing traditional arts groups.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: NAC will build capabilities and enhance research on the traditional arts under Our SG Arts Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: For example, the newly revamped Stamford Arts Centre (SAC) will house a mix of traditional arts groups from our multi-ethnic communities who can bring our rich cultural traditions closer to the community.

sections.label: International arts collaboration with MFA
sections.summary: Under Our SG Arts Plan, NAC will work with MFA on regional collaboration, international residencies and capability building, and overseas presence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Under Our SG Arts Plan, NAC will continue to work with MFA to (a) establish Singapore as a valuable collaborative partner for arts and culture in the region; (b) develop international residencies and capability building programmes; and (c) extend an effective Singapore presence overseas.
